purpose: Development inventory and fail-closed coverage contract. This is not a complete FDA/EU regulatory criteria inventory or a declaration of formal readiness.

profiles.qualificationReason: Independent checks and external qualification are incomplete.

profiles.description: US M1 3.3 development scope; current FDA source unverified
profiles.qualificationReason: Current FDA sources, complete regional criteria and external qualification remain unverified.
Atomic EU criteria implementation and external comparison remain incomplete.

rules.title: Explicit sequence selection and unambiguous package layout
rules.applicableScope: All directory and ZIP registrations; multiple candidate sequences require explicit selection.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Controlled directory paths and links
rules.applicableScope: All physical input roots, children and logical names; portable aliases, reparse points and escaping paths are rejected.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Bounded directory and ZIP input capture
rules.applicableScope: All inputs: entry count including inferred directories, single-file and total bytes, path limits and elapsed time are bound to the report.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Safe and unique ZIP entries
rules.applicableScope: Every ZIP entry, including directories and portable name collisions.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Bounded archive expansion and execution
rules.applicableScope: ZIP entry count, per-file and expanded total bytes, compression ratio and elapsed time; limits are part of report identity.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Input content remains identical throughout validation
rules.applicableScope: All input and selected historical content; changes invalidate this run.
rules.implementationNote: P2-02 controlled capture and rejection tests are implemented. Per-run coverage integration and complete cross-platform qualification remain pending; no formal readiness is claimed.

rules.title: Explicit historical source selection and trust
rules.applicableScope: Required history resolves in explicitly selected versions; no repository or filename fallback.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 resolves only explicitly selected captures, preserves unverified/rejected trust, and blocks unsupported profile compatibility. Persisted evidence authentication and authorization remain P2-06.

rules.title: Only pinned offline XML resources are resolved
rules.applicableScope: All ICH and regional XML resources; unknown network/system resources and external entities are rejected.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.title: Bounded XML depth, node count and entity expansion
rules.applicableScope: All backbone XML, including historical XML.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: validationBinding.profileSnapshotId; Appendix 6, regional backbone per submission (PDF p. 99 / printed 6-2)
rules.title: Declared XML versions match explicit profile snapshot
rules.applicableScope: ICH and regional declarations, namespaces and DTD versions must match the explicit selection.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification. P2-04 also rejects a missing regional backbone reference, even if the ICH DTD permits empty M1.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, Structure; Appendix 8, XML eCTD DTD
rules.title: ICH backbone structure and mandatory attributes
rules.applicableScope: ICH backbone content models, child order, required attributes and allowed values.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: Bundled US M1 3.3 DTD; official version/source verification pending
rules.title: US regional backbone structure
rules.applicableScope: US regional backbone only; bundled asset validity does not establish current FDA compliance.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: EU M1 3.1.1 asset manifest and published implementation timeline
rules.title: EU regional backbone structure
rules.applicableScope: EU regional backbone only; business criteria inventory is tracked separately.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, ID attribute; Appendix 8, ID declarations
rules.title: Document-scoped unique XML IDs
rules.applicableScope: Every XML document has its own ID index; references retain backbone and fragment.
rules.implementationNote: Independent, bounded inspection against exact hash-verified embedded assets is implemented and tested. This validates the declared development XML scope, not current regional business criteria or whole-package regulatory qualification.

rules.title: Unambiguous attributed CTD node identities
rules.applicableScope: Ordinal parsed attributes and parent context distinguish repeated nodes; missing or ambiguous contexts remain visible.
rules.implementationNote: Independent ICH attributes, parent/content constraints, repeated-node ambiguity and extension structure are inspected. Stable mapping for unresolved extension identities and regional business/extension acceptance still require later P2/P6 work.

rules.title: Permitted extension positions and regional acceptance
rules.applicableScope: DTD-permitted nesting and explicit regional extension policy; DTD validity alone cannot close regional acceptance.
rules.implementationNote: Independent ICH attributes, parent/content constraints, repeated-node ambiguity and extension structure are inspected. Stable mapping for unresolved extension identities and regional business/extension acceptance still require later P2/P6 work.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, regional backbone reference (PDF p. 99 / printed 6-2), Operation Attribute and modified-file (PDF pp. 100-101 / printed 6-3-6-4)
rules.title: Leaf operation and modified-file semantics
rules.applicableScope: new, replace, append and delete; delete delivers no new content; evaluate permitted same-sequence append from pinned ICH source.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 validates independent new, required modified-file, empty delete checksum and no new delete content; regional references must be new. Same-sequence consultation and complex combinations remain NotEvaluated pending applicable policy.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, modified-file attribute and lifecycle examples
rules.title: Resolve exact modified-file URI from source backbone
rules.applicableScope: Resolve once against the containing XML; retain selected sequence, backbone and fragment.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 resolves once relative to the containing XML; exact sequence/backbone/fragment, query/scheme/escape/future rejection and explicit selection only. Windows positive and negative tests passed; no external-tool qualification is claimed.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, modified-file attribute and lifecycle examples
rules.title: Historical XML and target leaf exist
rules.applicableScope: Resolve the exact XML ID within the explicit history baseline, including href-free delete operations.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 distinguishes missing history/XML/ID, duplicate/non-leaf IDs, uninspected or invalid XML, and missing historical content; href-free delete is included. Missing prerequisites remain NotEvaluated, never a fallback match.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 6, Operation Attribute; examples of replace, append and delete
rules.title: Target effectiveness and operation chains
rules.applicableScope: Evaluate target effectiveness, replacement/deletion chains, append and same-sequence combinations against pinned rules.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 replays simple replace/append/delete against pre-sequence states. Inactive targets fail; unresolved historical effects propagate. Conflicting same-sequence operations, cycles and further append-branch operations remain NotEvaluated pending P3 policy.

rules.title: Historical target has compatible business context
rules.applicableScope: Application, node ancestry and identity attributes must match the explicit target policy.
rules.implementationNote: P2-04 compares exact independent ICH XML ancestry and identity attributes, preserving ambiguity. Regional identity and cross-profile compatibility remain NotEvaluated pending P6 policy.

rules.title: Referenced delivered files exist within scope
rules.applicableScope: Decode URI paths once, distinguish external links and resolve local leaf files; delete does not require new href.
rules.implementationNote: Independent exact captured-file resolution covers current/historical hrefs, application/future escape, missing history and external classification; query and unavailable-history semantics remain explicitly NotEvaluated.

rules.title: Declared leaf checksums match physical bytes
rules.applicableScope: Recompute MD5 for referenced physical delivery files, including regional backbone bytes.
rules.implementationNote: Declared MD5 is compared with reverified captured physical bytes, including historical payloads and regional XML; missing files remain unresolved. Delete checksum semantics are checked by lifecycle rules.

rules.title: index-md5.txt matches the exact index.xml bytes
rules.applicableScope: The sequence root checksum file and actual ICH index bytes.
rules.implementationNote: Checks checksum-file presence, bounded ASCII MD5 syntax and the actual captured index.xml MD5; positive four-sequence and physical-corruption cases execute independently of the writer.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 4, util/dtd and util/style tables; Appendix 8
rules.title: Required DTD and stylesheet assets match the profile
rules.applicableScope: Presence and pinned digests of necessary selected-profile delivery assets.
rules.implementationNote: Independent pinned DTD/module and declared XSL byte checks, processing instructions and bounded import/include traversal implemented. Creation-time stylesheet evidence, generated presentation-resource bases and regional style policy remain unqualified.

rules.title: Package structure and additional content inventory
rules.applicableScope: Record empty directories, extra top-level files and missing deliveries; distinguish required constraints from recommended folder names.
rules.implementationNote: Records empty directories, surrounding files and reachability from backbones/known utility assets; disconnected PDF cycles cannot qualify themselves. Regional structure and orphan-content acceptance remain unqualified.

rules.title: Final ZIP paths and bytes equal the delivery directory
rules.applicableScope: Compare both path sets and content digests when ZIP and corresponding directory are provided.
rules.implementationNote: Explicit directory/ZIP pairs compare exact paths, lengths, SHA-256, empty directories and extra ZIP content. Both captures bind the report; standalone ZIP parity remains NotEvaluated.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 2, pp. 2-3 to 2-4; Appendix 3, Folder and File Naming Conventions
rules.title: Profile-scoped file and folder naming rules
rules.applicableScope: Distinguish ICH recommendations and each region's verified mandatory limits.
rules.implementationNote: Independent captured-path checks implement pinned ICH lowercase tokens, one extension, 64-character names and 230-character paths. Regional limits/exceptions and acceptance remain unqualified; recommended directory spellings are not mandatory.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Specification for Submission Formats, PDF
rules.title: PDF content can be parsed completely
rules.applicableScope: Every delivered PDF; parse errors and unsupported inspection conditions must remain explicit.
rules.implementationNote: Every selected current/history PDF is inspected with PdfPig 0.1.15 strict parsing, bounded navigation and cooperative cancellation. Parse failures and unknown conditions remain explicit. Hard parser process isolation and external qualification remain pending.

rules.title: PDF encryption and permissions allow review
rules.applicableScope: Every delivered PDF; inaccessible/unknown permission state cannot be reported as passing.
rules.implementationNote: Independent captured-PDF facts reject observed encryption/restrictions and preserve unknown permission state. Complete parser/security coverage and regional external qualification remain pending.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Fonts; Definition of Subset; Notes on Embedding Japanese Fonts
rules.title: PDF font embedding and exceptions
rules.applicableScope: Applicable font rules and region-specific exceptions; unknown detection requires unresolved coverage.
rules.implementationNote: Observed additional unembedded fonts fail while ICH common-font exceptions are retained. Nested resources, full/subset embedding and regional exceptions always retain unresolved coverage.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, Hypertext Linking and Bookmarks; Page Numbering
rules.title: Bookmarks and document navigation
rules.applicableScope: Selected-profile navigation rules for each document and explicit unsupported conditions.
rules.implementationNote: Bounded raw outline traversal preserves destinations and reports the four-level recommendation without a hard failure. TOC/bookmark correspondence, page labels and initial-view consistency remain unevaluated.

rules.title: Internal PDF links resolve to files and destinations
rules.applicableScope: Current and historical files, page numbers and named destinations; external URLs are classified without arbitrary network retrieval.
rules.implementationNote: Raw GoTo/GoToR/URI, outlines, OpenAction and named destination tables resolve against the explicit capture set with exact page/name checks. Literal file specifications and once-decoded URIs are distinct. Unknown/chained/additional actions and unreadable targets remain unevaluated; external URLs are never fetched.

rules.sourceSection: Appendix 7, PDF; regional guidance required for other versions
rules.title: PDF format version accepted by selected profile
rules.applicableScope: PDF versions in the explicitly locked profile, with region-specific evidence.
rules.implementationNote: Independent parsed-version facts support the jointly accepted ICH PDF 1.4. Other versions remain NotEvaluated until regional evidence is qualified; the legacy 1.4-1.7 heuristic is not reused.

rules.sourceSection: Unverified current FDA validation criteria and technical conformance guide
rules.title: Complete and verified current FDA criteria inventory
rules.applicableScope: US profile includes administrative metadata, controlled vocabularies and all remaining regional rules; this explicit gap blocks qualification.
rules.implementationNote: Current source, effective dates and official rule IDs are unverified. Existing labels M1 3.3 / criteria 4.5 / guide 1.9 are not qualification evidence. P6 and external comparison must populate atomic regional criteria.

rules.sourceSection: EU M1 3.1.1 / validation criteria 8.2 implementation timeline
rules.title: Complete EU 3.1.1 / criteria 8.2 rule inventory
rules.applicableScope: EU profile includes envelope metadata, controlled vocabularies and all remaining regional checks.
rules.implementationNote: Version timeline and pinned assets are verified; individual official criteria and external comparison are not yet cataloged. P6 must populate and qualify atomic regional checks.

rules.title: Profile implementation qualified by external comparison
rules.applicableScope: External tool/version, exact package digest, actual report and explained rule differences qualify the implementation.
rules.implementationNote: No actual external package validation report is bound yet. P2-08/09 must qualify implementations and explicitly decide any per-run external evidence policy. A tool installation alone is not evidence.
